visual_logic.surface_detail: Slender, needle-like body with 'Iridescent Violet' and 'Slate' tones; very smooth, small-scale texture running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the 'Saber-Teeth' fangs at the front of the jaw, oriented perfectly parallel to the camera plane.

environment.water: Deep olive-tinted 'Greensand' water, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The cloud of bubbles, high particulate marine snow, and distant silhouettes of giant mosasaurs are shifted entirely into the lowest background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The saber-toothed predatory fish is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. Its straight, arrow-like trajectory is stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its fanged head, slender torso, fins (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
